visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens in a brightly lit office where a young man with pink hair and black-framed glasses is filming a selfie-style vlog. Behind him, several staff members are seated at desks with computers. (2) The setting transitions to the entrance of a CHIEN TU hotpot restaurant; various people are seen entering and posing. (3) Inside the restaurant, the camera focuses on hotpot ingredients. A hand is seen scooping large amounts of chopped green onions and garlic into a stainless steel individual hotpot filled with broth. (4) A woman is seen placing pieces of taro into a milky-white broth. Later, she eats a piece of cooked taro with a dog-ear AR filter on her face. (5) A different staff member pours beaten egg liquid over a bowl of glass noodles, which are then placed into the boiling hotpot. (6) A man with a beard and glasses is at a beverage station, filling a cup with soft-serve ice cream. (7) A woman is seen stuffing raw shrimp paste into a piece of fried bean curd skin using a small black spatula. (8) A man in a black shirt shows a plate of cooked fish slices and asks to be fed; the pink-haired man feeds him with chopsticks. (9) A young man with black hair sits at a table covered with multiple containers of shrimp paste, eating a bowl full of the cooked product. (10) The pink-haired man and the black-haired man are seen together at the end, holding a long receipt and pointing it towards the camera.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Fast-paced, high-energy electronic background music begins with a male voice speaking in a cheerful, broadcast-style tone. A short digital whoosh SFX occurs during a visual transition. (2) Vocal pitch increases as the narrator introduces hotpot 'factions.' A percussive 'ding' SFX marks the appearance of the 'Sauce Faction' text. (3) A wet, splashing sound effect is heard as green onions are scooped into the broth, followed by a cartoonish bubbling SFX. (4) For the 'Taro Faction,' a hollow thud SFX is heard as the taro hits the broth, accompanied by a feminine voice expressing delight. (5) A series of rapid digital UI 'pop' sounds accompany the text overlays for the 'Egg Faction,' followed by a soft sizzling ambient noise. (6) A mechanical whirring and liquid pouring sound occurs as ice cream is dispensed, followed by a 'slurping' foley effect. (7) High-frequency 'shimmer' SFX plays during the 'Handmade Faction' segment. (8) Chewing and 'crunch' sound effects are emphasized during the shrimp paste eating scenes, mixed with high-arousal vocal exclamations like 'Wow.' (9) The music swells in volume towards the end, concluding with a comedic register 'ding' sound and loud group laughter as the bill is presented.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Categorical Demonstration -> Climax/Product Showcase -> CTA/Comedy Outro
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote the CHIEN TU hotpot brand and its specific shrimp paste product by humorously categorizing different staff members' eating habits ('factions') and showing a large-scale consumption of the featured item.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Clear display of brand logos (CHIEN TU), specific focus on menu items (shrimp paste), and verbal/textual recommendations from the creators.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video utilizes a high-density editing style characteristic of social media shorts, with heavy use of AR filters, sound effects, and variety-show style captions to maintain viewer engagement during a brand promotion.
